summary: Iteration 2 (Section 3 data_source + data_counts auto lead-counts) tested end-to-end. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests passing in /app/backend/tests/test_rfp.py (reference rates, Apollo/VibeProspect/LinkedIn/Prospeo matrix, empty-source & zero-counts → 0, CPL/total math, CRUD + data_source/data_counts persistence on roundtrip, legacy iter-1 RFP without new fields loads gracefully, CSV/XLSX export contains data_source & data_counts). Frontend: full Playwright E2E — Section 3 input-data-source/input-data-counts present, all 4 sources verified (Apollo 10000, VibeProspect 10000, LinkedIn=VibeProspect, Prospeo 1000) against spec, race-condition fix verified (typed CPC value '012345' preserved across preview response), end-to-end save with Apollo + 10000 + HQL/AG CPCs → list shows 22,300 leads & $67,500 cost, edit-reload restores Apollo / 10000 / HQL=1500/$25/$37,500 & AG=300/$100/$30,000, CSV export contains data_source/data_counts/Apollo. Cleanup done.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_section3 fallback: if data_source is empty but row.lead_counts arrives non-zero from a stale client payload, the code falls back to r.lead_counts. Spec says 'if source empty OR counts=0, lead_counts should be 0'. Current implementation only zeroes when both source AND counts are missing; passing through r.lead_counts is a latent leak. Tightening to always recompute (lc=0 when source missing or counts<=0) would match spec exactly. Tests still pass because UI never sends non-zero stale lead_counts, but it's fragile.

RFPForm preview useEffect dependency uses JSON.stringify on section1 and section3.rows[].cpc — fine for now but could miss updates if new computed fields are added to section1. Consider stable hashing or scoped deps.

compute_data_universe still returns >0 when only one filter category is selected (other factors default to 1.0). Previously noted in iter-1 review and unchanged this iteration — minor, not in iter-2 scope.
rfpUtils.js emptyRFP defaults campaign_type_config.type='MQL' which auto-selects MQL on a brand-new RFP; matches expected demo behaviour but worth confirming.

Pydantic Section3Computation.data_source is Optional[str]=None, but the JSON serializer returns null for legacy docs while the form uses '' — already handled correctly in the React side (s3.data_source || '').
seed_data_creation: One TEST_Iter2_E2E RFP (EVCL050) created via UI and deleted via API at end of run. Pytest TestCRUD also creates and deletes its own TEST_ data.
